beliefs.proposition: The reported Launch rebound impression was primarily a presentation-coalescing defect rather than an authority-physics bounce.
assumptions: The desktop runtime path exercised the same Launch authority contract used by the tested Practice host
beliefs.last_update: Runtime diagnostics showed zero bounces and one terminal contact while the prior presentation mapped multiple impulse events to audible cues.
reopen_triggers: Any live run reports bounceCount above zero
Any observer hears multiple impact cues for one detonation

hypotheses.statement: Per-target impulse cues created a false rebound impression even though authority terminated the projectile on first contact.
hypotheses.mechanism: One detonation emitted multiple target impulse events, each formerly eligible to produce a local cue.
distinct_predictions: Coalescing audio to the detonation produces one contact cue
discriminating_predictions: If authority actually bounced, collision diagnostics would report a bounce before detonation
hypotheses.decision_change_condition: Reopen physics behavior if any exact runtime trace reports a nonzero bounce.
hypotheses.value_of_information: High because it separates a mechanics rewrite from a presentation correction.
hypotheses.proposed_discriminating_test: Exercise Launch in a two-client room and compare authority events with audible presentation count.

hypotheses.statement: The tick-334 failure was a rotated-rail closest-face transition during upward movement, not a Launch defect.
hypotheses.mechanism: Integer quantization shifted the closest rail face after KCC movement and produced a 31.8 mm correction against an already-reported contact.
distinct_predictions: A narrow upward same-contact allowance clears the exact seam
A planar embedded capsule remains fail-closed
discriminating_predictions: A global tolerance would also mask the sealed planar embed and is therefore invalid
hypotheses.decision_change_condition: Reopen the correction if unrelated colliders or downward/planar motion receive the allowance.
hypotheses.value_of_information: High because the longer run would otherwise remain unstable or collision safety would be weakened.
hypotheses.proposed_discriminating_test: Keep both the 360-tick exact run and sealed planar embed in the consolidated regression set.
